subject: Renewal procurement: vendor reboarding & PO split options
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-health.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@acme-health.com
Date: 2025-06-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + onboarding refresh for contract renewal (term change + capacity bump)

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from procurement at Acme Health — our renewal for Redwood (RDW-4532) is targeting an effective date of 2025-07-15. We are planning a term extension to 24 months and a capacity increase of ~45% across inference units. Before legal signs, procurement needs us to reboard Redwood as an active vendor in our procurement portal (compliance evidence + updated PO template).

I attached a vendor reboarding checklist and our PO template (Acme_PO_template_v2.pdf). Can you confirm:
- Who on Redwood will upload the SOC2 snapshot and the vendor questionnaire to Acme's portal?
- If we need to split the PO into two line items (base + overage pool), is that supported from your side?
- Any recommended timeline to avoid a gap in service?

We also may route the order through two internal cost centers — procurement needs to know if you can accept split POs and whether a single SOW or two POs is preferred operationally.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Health
procure@acme-health.com

Attachments: vendor-reboard-checklist.xlsx; Acme_PO_template_v2.pdf

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-health.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + onboarding refresh for contract renewal (term change + capacity bump)

Hi Maria — thanks for the packet and the heads up. We can absolutely support a 24-month term and the ~45% capacity uplift; happy to map the procurement flow so there’s no interruption. Quick answers up front:

- Upload ownership: Redwood can upload the SOC2 snapshot and the vendor questionnaire to your portal, but we need a portal invite (admin permalink) or a service account. If you prefer, we can also upload to a Drive folder and your procurement team can pick up the artifacts.
- PO split: We support split POs. Operationally we prefer a single subscription SOW with two PO references (base + overage) — that minimizes reconciliation work on our side. If Acme requires two independent POs, we can accept that but will need clear invoice mapping for the monthly usage billing.
- Timeline: To avoid gaps, target acceptance by 2025-07-01 so we can apply the new capacity on 2025-07-15. That gives legal + billing ~2 weeks.

Action plan proposal (short):
1) Acme sends portal invite or service account by 2025-06-16.
2) Redwood uploads SOC2 snapshot and vendor questionnaire by 2025-06-18. (Grace to own)
3) Redwood and Acme confirm PO format and split mapping by 2025-06-20. (Laura to lead PO coordination)
4) Final signatures & DocuSign by 2025-07-05.

@Grace: can you take the upload if we get the portal link?
@Karthik: once the PO format is confirmed, can you validate pricing tiers for the 45% uplift and confirm if we need a capacity addendum?

Maria — if that timeline works, I’ll mark tasks and send a DocuSign draft link once Laura confirms the PO flow.

Best,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

(Reference: Deal RDW-4532)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-health.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@acme-health.com
Date: 2025-06-12T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + onboarding refresh for contract renewal (term change + capacity bump)

Thanks Jonas — portal invite sent (admin role) and you should have received the email from procure@acme-health.com with the invite token. I reattached Acme_PO_template_v2.pdf (minor field changes) and included a suggested split:
- Line 1: Core subscription (24-month term) — PO #1
- Line 2: Overage pool (variable) — PO #2 (linked to usage billing)

Legal will still review the SOW; they prefer two POs but are okay with cross-referencing a single SOW. Please upload SOC2-snapshot-2024.pdf and complete the vendor checklist in the portal.

I also added our procurement lead for invoicing questions: Clara Ngu (clara.ngu@acme-health.com).

DocuSign link for the draft term sheet will be sent once you confirm PO mapping.

Regards,
Maria

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2024.pdf

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme-health.com>
Date: 2025-06-12T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: ACME reboard + PO split — owners and deliverables (please RSVP)

Team — forwarding Maria's note. Below are owners and immediate asks. Keep replies short; we need these items before EOD on the dates below.

Owners and next steps:
- Grace O'Connor: upload SOC2-snapshot-2024.pdf and the vendor-reboard-checklist.xlsx to Acme portal (portal invite is in Maria's email). Target: 2025-06-18. Mark which checklist rows are outstanding after upload.
- Laura Bennett: confirm PO split mapping and create two invoice templates that line up with our billing system. Reach out to Clara Ngu (clara.ngu@acme-health.com) if you need clarifications. Target: 2025-06-20.
- Karthik Iyer: confirm whether pricing requires an addendum for the 45% uplift (yes/no) and prepare a short note describing the charge mapping and whether we should push a capacity addendum. Target: 2025-06-19.

Risks: If portal access or DocuSign slips past 2025-06-24 we risk a delayed start; communicate escalations to me and I’ll loop legal.

Maria — we’ll reply with confirmations and the DocuSign draft once owners sign off.

Thanks,
Jonas
